title:
P0 · WIP — Lock Favorites against accidental unpin

Remark: Default lock and explicit unpin acknowledgement implemented; local/browser and all seven CI workflows must pass before completion. Chat-deletion retention is a separate task.

P0 · Planned — Named delete warning, 24-hour recycle bin and preserved Favorites

Remark: Current delete permanently removes original turns and pins. Implement reversible chat/project deletion, exact-name warnings, 24-hour recovery/expiry, and an explicit choice to keep or remove favorite snapshots. Preserve formatting; orphaned snapshots show unavailable source links. Requires storage/restore and expiry tests before delivery.

P1 · Planned — Retry or regenerate a reply with another model

Remark: Preserve original question, attachments and chat location. Keep prior reply available, record selected model/usage and never replay executed writes. Verify interrupted replies, parallel streams and reload.

P1 · Planned — Built-in live verification browser

Remark: Prepare a scoped browser view for UI smoke checks and user-controlled credential entry. Credentials must not become model-visible. External pages can refuse embedding; use a secure companion browser when required. No embedded browser delivered yet.

P1 · Planned — Administrator-configurable chat limits

Remark: Existing simultaneous-answer limit is three and request budgets are bounded. Add explicit settings for concurrent replies and per-chat history/message limits with safe bounds, migration and clear validation errors; do not silently discard history.

P1 · WIP — Simple gist first and remembered short-answer preference

Remark: skills/aimate-answer-style/SKILL.md records the requirement. Implement conversation-scoped runtime preference until user changes it, preserving the original query and keeping references from overriding it. Persistence/reopen and provider tests remain.

P1 · Planned — Artifactory connection and scoped reads

Remark: Implement a separate optional connector with secure token input, URL validation, green/partial/red checks, bounded artifact metadata/search and source citations. Do not download or execute binaries implicitly; live server access needs user settings.

P1 · Planned — Synchronize verified AiMate changes into Nexus

Remark: User authorized updating the existing Nexus AiMate application copy. Inspect its current feature branch and workflow requirements; copy only verified app source without .data, tokens, credentials or unrelated domain documents. Record exact source/destination commits and checks.

P0 · WIP — Encrypted selected commit-pinned Nexus knowledge index

Remark: Eight backend and one real-browser fixture checks pass; encrypted storage, explicit files, pinned provenance, paging, source revocation and disabled/private/role guards covered. All seven GitHub workflows and installed local import/search validation required. Broader remote ingestion and structured cases remain separate.
